public_rationale: The evidence supports recurring shortcomings rather than universal failure. Sora's developer acknowledged incorrect object-state changes, while a multi-family language-model evaluation found substantial errors even in its strongest entity tracker. Both sources also document real capabilities or improvements. Those successes qualify the claim's breadth but do not establish dependable reasoning across the situations tested.
limitations: This outcome depends on reading consistently as recurring gaps, not failure on every task.
The language-model study does not cover all frontier models available at the post date.
Sora's disclosure supplies examples and qualitative findings rather than a comprehensive error rate.
